answer: Calibrated Physical Effort Attestation. Each agent identity must submit a sensor log of a sustained physical task—say, a measured gale pushing a rotor for two hours—verified against a hardware root of trust whose plume of exhaust heat is sampled continuously. Any vertex in the log where effort drops below threshold voids the identity. Faking it requires real actuators, real fuel, and real time per identity, so mass registration scales linearly in joules and equipment, not in software: one operator cannot conjure a thousand identities without a thousand physical rigs running concurrently.
